scope: UIKit + simulated native host; not real SpringBoard or device media
checks: PASS: Valid host displays Harbor and hides only the native collection
PASS: Inset module panel does not constrain the full-window dashboard viewport
PASS: Backdrop fills the complete native background, including top and bottom
PASS: Native scroll/dismiss ancestry, panel geometry, and clipping stay unchanged
PASS: Dashboard has no ambiguous Auto Layout geometry
PASS: Native status/privacy header stays visible and receives touches
PASS: All controls is pinned visibly above the home-indicator safe area
PASS: Lower shortcut is fully scroll-reachable while native escape stays fixed
PASS: Native scroll offsets do not move the dashboard out of its viewport
PASS: Dashboard inherits native presentation transforms without cancelling or changing them
PASS: Native handoff stops both visible-only timers
PASS: Connections restores native hierarchy
PASS: Connections resolves an actual installed module identifier
PASS: Native selection persists across layout callbacks
PASS: Reopening starts a fresh Harbor visit
PASS: Focus resolves and requests its native panel
PASS: Master switch immediately restores native controls
PASS: Settings diagnostics preserve the reason native controls were retained
PASS: Master switch re-enables the active portrait dashboard
PASS: Expanded native modules are never covered
PASS: Dismissal removes the child controller and restores native state
PASS: Pre-existing hidden state is restored exactly
PASS: Unexpected native hierarchy fails open
PASS: A collection outside the presentation container remains visible
PASS: A missing presentation container restores the native collection
PASS: Missing full-screen background retains native controls
PASS: An overscanned native blur background is accepted without resizing it
PASS: A detached Control Center host cannot keep Harbor visible
PASS: Landscape resize restores native controls
PASS: Returning to portrait restores the complete Harbor viewport
PASS: Ending presentation removes both content and backdrop; layout cannot reopen it
PASS: Empty media disables transport
PASS: Playing media enables transport with accurate accessibility label
PASS: Invalid palette falls back to Sea Glass
PASS: Palette preference round trips
PASS: Inactive media provider rejects commands
PASS: Standalone fixture uses unambiguous shipping UI
PASS: Long media stays within a 300pt viewport
PASS: All controls stays pinned and reachable at 300pt

PASS: All controls stays pinned and reachable at 320pt
PASS: Long media stays within a 375pt viewport
PASS: All controls stays pinned and reachable at 375pt

PASS: All controls stays pinned and reachable at 430pt
